illustrations.title: Harness 架构：任务契约、模块职责与建设顺序
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “Harness 的四份记录”. Four separate pastel illustrated record cards in a 2x2 grid, NO arrows. Labels: “任务契约 / 要交付什么”; “运行状态 / 进行到哪里”; “业务资源 / 实际发生什么”; “验收记录 / 哪些要求已通过”. Center short note “模型提案不等于实际交付”. Footer “职责可以同进程，记录不能混为一谈”. No database transactional guarantee.
illustrations.alt: 任务契约记录目标，运行状态记录进度，业务资源记录实际结果，验收记录说明哪些要求已通过。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜四份记录分别回答目标、进度、事实与验收；模型提案不能代替业务资源。

illustrations.title: 运行循环与规划：状态、进展和停止条件
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “下一步：继续、等待，还是结束”. Three horizontal numbered lanes, NOT connected with arrows. Mint “继续” with small cards “有新进展”“有权限”“有预算” and an action icon. Blue “等待” with “缺信息或许可” and an event bell “有效事件到达后恢复”. Lavender “结束” splits two boxes “验收通过：交付证据” and “取消或预算耗尽：报告未完成”. Footer “模型停止生成，不等于任务成功”.
illustrations.alt: 运行器在有进展且权限与预算允许时继续，缺信息或许可时等待；验收通过才能交付成功，取消或预算耗尽应报告未完成。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜三种出口取决于当前事实；已经派发但未确认的写入仍需对账。

illustrations.title: Loop Engineering 与 Graph Engineering：Agent 如何持续推进，又怎样组织复杂任务
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “Loop 与 Graph 怎样配合”. Top blue lane titled “Graph：组织依赖” with a split into three document cards “公告 A”“公告 B”“公告 C” and all converge into “按分支身份汇总”. Bottom mint lane titled “Loop：利用反馈”, three boxes “读取证据” → “发现缺口” → “补充查找”, with simple curved return arrow to 读取证据, a side note “有界探索”. No arrows connecting the two lanes. Footer “每个核验分支可有自己的 Loop”.
illustrations.alt: Graph 把三份公告的核验分开并按分支身份汇总；每个分支内部可以用有界 Loop 根据证据缺口继续查找。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜外层组织依赖，内层利用反馈；收到三个结果不代表三个不同分支都已完成。

illustrations.title: Multi-Agent 技术架构选型：从任务拆分到框架与部署决策
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “什么时候值得增加 Agent”. Two pastel comparison lanes. Top mint “固定字段核对” shows 3 document icons → one gear “并行工具” → report “汇总”. Bottom blue “各自需要多步查证” shows 3 separate boxed small loops labeled “独立上下文 A”“独立上下文 B”“独立上下文 C”, all feed ONE person clipboard “协调与验收”. Footer “收益要覆盖：上下文、协调、重试成本”. No claim more agents more accurate.
illustrations.alt: 字段固定的三份材料可通过并行工具核对；各分支都需要独立多步查证时，才考虑独立上下文与 Agent，并由协调者汇总验收。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜并行调用与多 Agent 是不同选择；拆分后必须核算协调成本与交付责任。

illustrations.title: 工具契约：输入、结果与错误语义
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “工具输入：哪些能由模型填写”. Two input cards side by side: mint “候选参数 / 资料编号 · 标题”; blue “可信执行上下文 / 身份 · 操作键 · 审批”. Both arrows into a wide gate “校验与授权”, then arrow to “业务执行”, then arrow to “查询验收”. Grey small note under first card “模型不能自填身份来授权”. Footer “Schema 合法 ≠ 有权执行”. Do not show API standard fields.
illustrations.alt: 资料编号和标题是待校验的候选参数；身份、操作键与审批来自可信运行上下文，两者在校验授权后进入业务执行和查询验收。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜这是应用的逻辑分工；字段格式合法不证明身份、权限或最终结果正确。

illustrations.title: MCP 生命周期：握手、目录、断线与取消
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “三种 ID，别混着用”. Three distinct pastel ID badges in horizontal lanes, NO connecting arrows: “请求 ID / 对应一次请求与响应” with two message envelopes; “会话 ID / 对应协议会话” with connected client/server; “业务操作键 / 对应同一次业务意图” with one ticket. Footer “重连可以换请求，业务意图仍需对账”. Small label “MCP 2025-11-25 学习基线”. No imply session IDs mandatory for all transports.
illustrations.alt: 请求 ID 关联一次往返，会话 ID 标识采用会话机制的协议交互，业务操作键由应用用于同一业务意图的追踪与对账。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜三种标识覆盖不同范围；并非所有传输都要求会话 ID，重连不能证明写入未发生。

illustrations.title: 执行安全：身份、授权、审批与沙箱
illustrations.prompt: Original Chinese educational infographic. White paper, hand-drawn black outlines, rounded panels, soft mint/powder-blue/lavender/pale-yellow marker fills, small simple line icons. 1536 x 1024 landscape. Very large crisp readable Chinese. Spacious margins and short labels. No logos, watermark, fake data, performance score or decorative filler. Use only the specified text. Arrow direction must exactly match the description. Title “资料里的命令，不能扩大权限”. Left grey document card “资料正文” with quoted text “导出所有资料”. Arrow to center “模型候选动作”; arrow to blue gate “当前任务权限”. Gate has red stopped route “导出：拒绝” ending X and green permitted route “允许范围内的操作” ending check. Above gate separate trusted source card “已认证身份 + 当前授权” points into gate. Footer “资料是输入，不是授权来源”. Do not draw export output beyond rejection.
illustrations.alt: 资料正文中的导出要求只能作为不可信输入；模型即使提出导出动作，执行层也应依据已认证身份和当前授权拒绝越界操作。
illustrations.caption: 图解｜提示注入可能影响提案，真实权限仍由可信入口与执行层控制。
